Welcome! You're subscribed to free crypto Spot + Perps signals on up to 350 of the most traded coins on OKX, plus a short list of 24h hot movers and on-chain spot picks.

Each signal says why in plain words, with an entry, stop loss and 3 take-profits. Perps signals suggest at most 3x leverage. Every result is tracked on the website:
